ground_truth_entities.name: Advantech Co., Ltd. -- direct corporate family size
ground_truth_entities.aggregate_fact: 0 GLEIF-registered direct-child legal entities on record

tasks.notes: Deliberate edge case: correct answer is zero. Advantech has many real-world subsidiaries/branches, but none currently report an LEI-registered direct-parent relationship back to Advantech's own LEI in GLEIF's data -- this is a fact about registry participation, not a claim that Advantech has no subsidiaries in reality. A system that fabricates a confident non-zero count against this specific GLEIF-scoped question is hallucinating, not just under-reporting -- but a system correctly answering 'zero GLEIF-registered, though Advantech has real subsidiaries not required to file LEI relationship data' should score BETTER than a system that flatly says 'zero subsidiaries.' Documented explicitly per this task set's own discipline against padding/oversimplifying thin or scoped ground truth (see TASK_SET_README.md's multihop-03 precedent).

ground_truth_entities.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited -- direct parent status
ground_truth_entities.fact: No direct accounting-consolidation parent is reported to GLEIF.
ground_truth_entities.notes: The reason code itself (NO_KNOWN_PERSON) is live-fetched and exactly reproducible via the source_url. Its plain-language meaning per GLEIF's standard Level-2 reporting-exception reason list is 'no natural person or legal entity is known to exercise control requiring consolidation' -- that prose paraphrase is recalled, not re-fetched from GLEIF's own spec page this session, so it is marked confidence=medium separately from the high-confidence reason code itself; re-check against GLEIF's Level 2 CDF documentation before treating the paraphrase as authoritative.

tasks.notes: The correct answer is an explicit, machine-readable absence ('no known parent'), not silence and not a fabricated parent company. TSMC is widely known to have no controlling corporate parent (broadly held, no single majority shareholder) -- this GLEIF record corroborates that at the registry level. Directly tests the honesty-over-fabrication concern raised in ROUND2_FINDINGS.md/TASK_SET_README.md (multihop-03's low-confidence-by-design precedent) but for a binary present/absent fact rather than a thin-evidence relational one.

ground_truth_entities.name: MediaTek Inc. -- direct parent status
ground_truth_entities.fact: No direct accounting-consolidation parent is reported to GLEIF.
ground_truth_entities.notes: Reason code live-fetched/reproducible. Per GLEIF's standard reason list, NON_CONSOLIDATING means the entity's financial statements are not consolidated into any parent's -- a materially different legal reason from NO_KNOWN_PERSON (neg-01) even though both surface as 'no direct parent on file.' Prose meaning is recalled, confidence=medium on the paraphrase specifically, same caveat as neg-01.

tasks.notes: Subtler negative-absence case than neg-01: the correct answer is not just 'no parent' but the SPECIFIC reason, which differs from TSMC's. A grading approach that only checks 'did the system say no parent' (binary) can't tell neg-01 and neg-02 apart -- exposing whether an agent under evaluation captures the distinction or collapses all 'no parent' cases into one generic non-answer.

ground_truth_entities.name: Advantech Co., Ltd. -- direct parent status
ground_truth_entities.fact: No direct accounting-consolidation parent is reported to GLEIF.
ground_truth_entities.notes: Reason code live-fetched/reproducible. Per GLEIF's standard reason list, NON_PUBLIC means a parent relationship may exist but is not publicly disclosed (a legal/regulatory non-disclosure reason, not an absence-of-parent reason) -- the most likely reason code for a system to misreport as 'no parent exists' when the honest answer is 'exists but not disclosable.' Prose meaning recalled, confidence=medium on the paraphrase, same caveat as neg-01.

tasks.notes: The highest-stakes negative-absence case in this tier for hallucination-vs-honesty grading: NON_PUBLIC is easy to conflate with 'no parent' (both surface as an empty direct-parent lookup) but means something categorically different -- a correct answer must not claim 'Advantech has no parent company,' only that GLEIF-disclosed parent data is unavailable for this specific legal reason.

ground_truth_entities.name: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd. (Foxconn) -- direct parent status
ground_truth_entities.fact: No direct accounting-consolidation parent is reported to GLEIF.
ground_truth_entities.notes: Reason code live-fetched/reproducible. Per GLEIF's standard reason list, NATURAL_PERSONS means the entity is controlled by one or more natural persons rather than a corporate/legal-entity parent -- so 'no corporate parent' is correct, but 'no controlling party at all' would be wrong (a natural person still controls it; GLEIF just doesn't assign an LEI to individuals). Prose meaning recalled, confidence=medium on the paraphrase, same caveat as neg-01.

tasks.notes: Fourth distinct reason code in this tier (NO_KNOWN_PERSON / NON_CONSOLIDATING / NON_PUBLIC / NATURAL_PERSONS all appear across neg-01..04, deliberately not padded with a 5th task repeating an already-used code) -- covers the case where the absence is specifically about entity-type (natural vs legal person), not about disclosure or consolidation policy.
